description.text: There would be Entrance Examinations for applicants: Date: Every July Contents: Internal Classics, Specialty, Chinese Language Medical Insurance: 600 RMB/Year (1,000 RMB for 45 Year-old or Elder)

duration.text: The Theories of TCM at Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Postgraduate school transcript 4.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Applicants should meet one of the following requirements: TCM Masters Degree; Masters of Concerning Western Medicine Subjects, and has completed the designated courses.
